name: GCP VPC Firewall and VPN Tampering
description: VPC firewall rules and VPN tunnels are the doors in and out of a GCP project. Opening a rule or deleting a VPN can expose a database or drop a site-to-site link. Attackers open ingress for access, or kill VPN as disruption. Nothing about IAM has to change for this to work. 0.0.0.0/0 on administrative ports, and unexpected VPN deletion, are the loud changes.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
